macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks retreat after sharp AI-led rally
items.summary: The Dow rose 0.85% to 50,018.69, while the S&P 500 fell 0.50% to 7,201.09 and the Nasdaq dropped 1.48% to 23,733.53 as investors took profits in technology shares and assessed tariff risks.[2]

items.title: Markets raise bets on a December Fed rate hike
items.summary: Traders priced in roughly a 95% probability of a 25-basis-point Federal Reserve rate increase in December. New York Fed President John Williams said persistent inflation continued to argue for tighter monetary policy.[5][9]

items.title: Fed discount-rate minutes show broad regional-bank support for a hike
items.summary: Minutes from the Fed’s October discount-rate meetings indicated that directors at eight of the 12 regional Federal Reserve Banks recommended raising the discount rate from 4% to 4.25% before the October policy meeting.[2]

items.title: Consumer confidence jumps in November
items.summary: The Conference Board’s consumer-confidence index rose 11.4 points to 103.3, exceeding economists’ expectations and reaching its highest level since early 2025.[2]

items.title: Nvidia CEO reinstatement drives major AI-stock volatility
items.summary: Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia chief executive triggered a major technology rally in the prior session, but Nvidia and other AI-related stocks surrendered much of those gains as investors reassessed valuations and risks.[5]

items.title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise shares fall after results
items.summary: HPE shares dropped about 12% in premarket trading despite fiscal-fourth-quarter revenue of $14.55 billion and free cash flow of $1.92 billion, both above cited consensus estimates.[1][5]

items.title: Dollar Tree raises outlook after earnings beat
items.summary: Dollar Tree reported third-quarter adjusted earnings of $1.16 per share versus a $0.92 consensus estimate, with revenue of $5.07 billion, and raised its annual profit forecast; shares gained about 8.6%.[5][6]

items.title: Analog Devices guides below expectations
items.summary: Analog Devices shares fell about 17% after the chipmaker issued adjusted first-quarter earnings guidance below market expectations.[3]

items.title: Bank of Canada warns energy costs could prolong inflation
items.summary: Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem said higher energy costs would continue passing through to consumer prices, intensifying persistent inflation pressures.[2]

items.title: Bitcoin falls below $60,000 amid renewed technology-stock pressure
items.summary: Bitcoin dropped below $60,000 as AI and technology shares came under renewed selling pressure.[2]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin falls back toward $60,000 amid ETF outflows
items.summary: Bitcoin declined roughly 2% in 24 hours to about $60,350, while November spot Bitcoin ETF redemptions reportedly reached a record $4.71 billion. Ethereum and several major altcoins also weakened.[1][2]

items.title: South Korea proposes allowing domestic ICOs
items.summary: South Korea’s draft Digital Asset Industry Innovation and User Protection Act would permit domestic initial coin offerings and won-denominated stablecoins while proposing a 20% ownership cap for major crypto-exchange shareholders.[2][3]

items.title: CFTC permits crypto assets in derivatives firms’ financial resources
items.summary: U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission guidance allows regulated derivatives venues to count Bitcoin, Ether and qualifying payment stablecoins toward financial-reserve requirements, subject to valuation discounts.[7][8]

items.title: U.S. seeks recovery of $1.1 billion linked to Binance hack
items.summary: U.S. prosecutors filed an action seeking to recover more than $1.1 billion in cryptocurrency allegedly stolen in a Binance-related hack attributed to North Korea-linked actors.[1][5]

items.title: Payoneer receives conditional approval for stablecoin trust bank
items.summary: Payoneer received preliminary conditional approval from the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to establish PAYO Digital Bank, a proposed national trust bank focused on digital-asset and stablecoin services.[1]

items.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money-market fund in Hong Kong
items.summary: BlackRock reportedly launched a tokenized money-market fund in Hong Kong with approximately $100 million in initial assets and support for stablecoin subscriptions.[2]

items.title: Chainflip reports $12.6 million vault outflow
items.summary: Chainflip said attackers transferred approximately 133 BTC, 520 ETH, 3.25 million USDC and 758,000 USDT from its Bitcoin and Ethereum vaults, totaling about $12.6 million at the time of the incident.[4]

items.title: Ethereum Foundation expands protocol security team
items.summary: The Ethereum Foundation said it doubled its protocol security team to address emerging quantum-computing and artificial-intelligence threats.[8]

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Hacker leak reportedly enables unofficial GTA 6 PC port
items.summary: A stolen Xbox build file for Grand Theft Auto VI was reportedly released, potentially enabling an unofficial PC port before Rockstar announces an official version. The report raises concerns about piracy and further leaks.

items.title: LG Display partners with Riot Games’ VCT EMEA
items.summary: LG Display announced an official partnership with Riot Games’ VALORANT Champions Tour EMEA league as part of an effort to expand its presence in the global esports market.

items.title: AI-generated games prompt suspension of Atari homebrew awards
items.summary: The Atari Homebrew Awards were suspended after organizers said a flood of AI-made submissions undermined the retro-development competition and made judging impractical.

items.title: Nioh 3 announced for Xbox in January 2027
items.summary: Koei Tecmo announced that Nioh 3’s second and final DLC will arrive next month, followed by the action game’s Xbox release in January 2027 after years of PlayStation exclusivity.

items.title: VCT 2027 EMEA Kickoff qualifiers begin
items.summary: The VCT 2027 EMEA Kickoff: Europe qualifier playoffs are scheduled for November 25 through December 5, with NAVI Junior among the participating teams.

items.title: Imperial defeats 100 Thieves at PGL Major Singapore
items.summary: Imperial beat 100 Thieves 13–11 in Round 2 of Stage 1 at the PGL Major Singapore 2026 Counter-Strike tournament.

items.title: GTA 6 drives gaming hardware sales
items.summary: Best Buy reported a 27.5% year-over-year increase in entertainment sales, with customers upgrading gaming setups ahead of major releases including Grand Theft Auto VI.
